title: Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation
author: Mo Xiang Tong Xiu
description: Reincarnated into the body of a notorious lunatic, the dreaded Demonic Founder Wei Wuxian is reunited with his former peer and righteous cultivator, Lan Wangji. As the two unravel a web of dark mysteries plaguing the cultivation world, they must confront ghosts of the past and a blossoming, unexpected bond. This epic tale of magic, mystery, and redemption explores the depths of loyalty and love against a backdrop of supernatural danger.
